mentions.name: HIDMorph
mentions.description: An open-source HID remapping device with one USB-in and one USB-out that converts keyboard input to joystick input or adds macros to specific inputs. In programming mode it mounts as a USB drive for LUA scripts and log files; in run mode it runs a selected LUA script that can read incoming mouse/joystick/keyboard data, generate outgoing HID data, or log events to a CSV file. A parts list and Gerber files will be exported so others can build one themselves.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still the same HID remapping project from last month (I was hoping to be done by now, but hardware is hard):
https://github.com/cedarhacks/HIDMorph

This is an HID ReMapping device, things like converting keyboard input to joystick input, or adding macros to specific inputs.
